summary: Pinnacle Food Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy statement for a 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting set for October 2, 2026, and a concurrent meeting of Class B holders. Holders of record as of September 15, 2026 may vote on two special resolutions: increasing Class B voting power from five to twenty votes per share, and adopting a Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles. The Board unanimously recommends both proposals. This is a routine governance/EGM notice, not a special situation; watch dual-class control consolidation risk.
